Strategy & Business Operations Manager at Superorder

# About Superorder

Founded in 2019, Superorder provides an all-in-one software platform that simplifies the way restaurants operate in the digital era by automating every aspect of running an online restaurant business. Our software empowers restaurants to grow their business by enabling them to create multiple virtual storefronts, centralizing order management, building quick AI websites, allowing them to understand their financials, and more. We work with more than a thousand restaurants in 150+ cities and to date have processed more than 1.5M orders. Our mission is to simplify tech adoption so restaurant owners can focus on what they love — cooking great food.

Superorder is backed by some of the world’s best investors: Foundation, Y Combinator, Floodgate, Slow Ventures, and SV Angel. We are also backed by amazing angels like Michael Seibel (Managing Director, Y Combinator), Babak Nivi (Cofounder AngelList), Kyle Vogt (CEO, Cruise), Daniel Kan (Cofounder, Cruise), Ryan Delk (CEO, Primer), and many more.

We raised our series A and are growing quickly — come join us!

# Our Values

1. All In: Be driven, dedicated, and committed. Give it your all to win.
2. Frugality: Aim to do more with less.
3. Be different: Encourage contrarian thinking and embrace diverse viewpoints.
4. Adapt or Die: The world is constantly changing - we need to be good at adapting to new realities everyday.
5. Ownership Mentality: We see things through to the finish, and take responsibility for outcomes.
6. Customer Obsessed: We always put our customers first and prioritize what’s best for them every step of the way.

# Why Superorder?

We are a dynamic and innovative restaurant technology startup, passionate about revolutionizing the food industry. As we continue to expand our team, we are seeking individuals who are adept at analytical thinking, growth opportunities, and who possess a strong sense of ownership in the way we develop our software brand. We want individuals who can bring fresh perspectives, share in our enthusiasm for the latest technology trends, and work collaboratively to drive forward our vision. Join us on this exciting journey of transforming food delivery!

# How You’ll Make an Impact

- As a Strategy & Business Operations Manager at Superorder, you'll identify and scope internal projects, navigate ambiguity, collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders across the business, and manage timelines and delivery.
- Analyze and visualize data using SQL and other tools to identify trends and build dashboards for operations.
- Document current state processes and design onboarding workflows for new products; specify and build internal tooling and task management processes.
- Be a utility player to provide firepower to solve any problem across the business: ask questions, be resourceful, learn quickly, and bring a can-do attitude.

# We’re hiring an Onboarding Specialist to help restaurants turn one-star Yelp rants into polite DMs (and get them set up for success). | Superorder · LinkedIn · 2025-09-18

**Superorder**: Superorder is an AI agent company that supercharges restaurants by managing reputation, maximizing delivery profitability, and powering smarter customer experiences. Superorder has 10-20 employees and has annual revenue in the $1M-$10M range, founded in 2019. Headquartered in New York City, United States, with offices in New York and San Francisco. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Japan, and Puerto Rico. Has $12.5M in total funding, with 3 prior funding rounds.

---

We’re hiring an Onboarding Specialist to help restaurants turn one-star Yelp rants into polite DMs (and get them set up for success).

Apply here → https://lnkd.in/eEEwg8fX

**Reshared from [Raghav Poddar](https://linkedin.com/in/bypoddar):**
> We’re hiring an Onboarding Specialist to keep restaurants from face-planting on Google, Yelp, and DoorDash.
>
> We’re an AI-powered platform helping mid-market and enterprise restaurants nail their online presence and look like 5-star heroes instead of Yelp horror stories.
>
> The job:
> - Guide new restaurant partners through setup and training so they hit the ground running.
> - Help them turn one-star rants into polite DMs and boost re-order rates with our AI tools.
> - Be the calm, organized partner franchise owners wish they had during their last audit.
>
> Ideally, you’re:
> - Tech-comfortable: Not an engineer, but you can walk a GM through a dashboard without breaking a sweat.
> - Personable: Franchise owners actually enjoy your calls.
> - Organized: Juggle multiple onboardings at once and still look unbothered.
> - Empathetic: You get the grind of running a restaurant and care about making their lives easier.
>
> Why us?
> - Backed by Y Combinator, Floodgate, SV Angel, Foundation Capital, and operators like Michael Seibel (Cofounder, Twitch), Ram Shriram (Board Member, Google), Kyle Vogt (Cofounder, Cruise), and Jon Swanson (Cofounder, Thumbtack)
> - Over $12M raised to date
> - Revenue’s up, and we’re not lighting VC cash on fire.
> - You’ll join a small, fun team where people actually laugh on Zoom.
>
> Bonus points: If you’ve worked in restaurant tech, or if guilt-tipping 25% is your love language.
>
> Apply on this link -> https://lnkd.in/eAeaFh9S
>
> Please don’t send me generic “looking for a job” emails. We care about effort and fit - apply on the typeform directly.

## Comments

> I applied, crossing fingers

**[Likith Menon](https://linkedin.com/in/likith-menon-105a75236)** · 2025-09-22

Superorder | AI Agents for Restaurants

# AI Agents for Restaurant Reputation and Delivery Profitability

Superorder’s AI Agents supercharge restaurants by managing reputation, maximizing delivery profitability, and powering smarter customer experiences.

Trusted by Leading Restaurant Brands Globally

7x Customer Retention

6M+ Annual Reviews Processed

$10B+ Annual Client GMV

## Real-Time Feedback that Powers Smarter Customer Experiences

Powered by AI-driven surveys and real-time insights, Superorder captures every guest voice and transforms it into action. By surfacing issues before they become public reviews and amplifying happy customer moments, our connected feedback engine closes the loop instantly — driving loyalty, smarter decisions, and long-term growth at scale.

Benefits

Boost 5-Star Reviews

Guide happy customers to leave reviews on Google and Yelp.

Reduce 1 and 2 Stars

AI Agents engage unhappy customers and enroll into recovery workflows.

Immediate Engagements

Surveys are sent instantly by AI, delivering 11%+ response rates.

Improve SEO

Higher ratings boost your ranking on Google Maps and search engines.

## AI-Powered Engagement That Builds Trust

The AI Review Management Agent delivers personalized, on-brand replies, turning complaints into recoveries and happy customers into loyal advocates. By curating order-level responses and automating every customer at scale, every guest feels heard, building trust and repeat visits.

## AI Agents That Maximize Delivery Profitability

From automated reconciliation to real-time financial reporting, Superorder ensures your delivery business stays accurate and profitable. Our AI Agents track downtime and send smart alerts, so you never miss the details that impact your bottom line.

Real-Time Alerts

Receive instant emails, texts, and notifications based on store-level activity.

Consolidated Reporting

Aggregate all your third-party data for a complete understanding of how your restaurant's online business is performing.

Financial Reconciliation

Instant financial reconciliation for third-party delivery, saving dozens of hours per month.

Downtime Management

Auto-restart offline stores to prevent revenue losses due to unintentional downtime

## Drive Performance With Insights You Can Act On

Superorder turns holistic feedback and operational data into actionable insights that drive performance. Our AI Agent surfaces trends, sentiment, and improvement areas across every channel — delivering real-time scorecards that help teams focus on what matters most, resolve issues faster, and fuel growth at scale.

AI analyzes patterns across all customer feedback to identify emerging trends and recurring issues.

Actionable Feedback

Turn customer feedback into action items for your stores to improve.

Pattern Recognition

_request.query:
Company: Superorder (website https://superorder.com).
Test to verify: Actively hiring now, with at least one open go-to-market role.
How it is tested: At least one requisition listed today on the company's own careers page or ATS board with a GTM title: sales, marketing, growth, ABM, demand generation, SDR or BDR, partnerships, revenue operations.
Decide pass, fail or unclear for THIS company today, citing the freshest relevant source.
_request.systemPrompt: Today is 2026-09-10. You are verifying one qualification test for one specific company. Use only what the sources say. The most recent dated announcement of an event is the authority on the company's current state; older announcements are history; company profile pages (LinkedIn, Crunchbase, CB Insights, Tracxn) are secondary to the company's own pages and to dated news. Never confuse the company with a same-name company on a different website. Answer pass only when a source states the fact; fail only when a source contradicts the test; otherwise unclear. The evidence_quote must be copied verbatim from the cited source.

reasoning.description: One or two sentences: what the freshest relevant source says and how it decides the test.

evidence_quote.description: A verbatim sentence or fragment from the cited source that decides the verdict; empty if unclear.

evidence_url.description: The URL the quote comes from; empty if unclear.

evidence_date.description: The date of that source as shown on it (YYYY-MM-DD if known); empty if unknown.
